Name: Willy Shop Expanded
Author: elonsquidion
Description:
Willy's Fish Shop now sells Curiosity Lure, Quality Bobber, Wild Bait, Challenge Bait, and Magic Bait.

However, there are conditions that players must fulfill before purchasing:
[list]
[*]Curiosity Lure: Skill Fishing Level 9

[*]Quality Bobber: Has Crafting Recipe for Quality Bobber
[*]Wild Bait: Has Crafting Recipe for Wild Bait

[*]Challenge Bait: Has Crafting Recipe for Challenge Bait

[*]Magic Bait: Already Opened Qi's Walnut Room or Found 100 Golden Walnuts
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Willy's Fish Shop now sells Curiosity Lure, Quality Bobber, Wild Bait, and Challenge Bait.

However, player must have minimum 9 level of fishing to buy Curiosity Lure. Also, already have the crafting recipe for each those tackle and baits.
